The Experience

There is nothing quite like it — the hush as the light fades, the glow of the big screen, and a story unfolding beneath the stars with the people you love most beside you.

We bring the complete cinema to you: a stunning large screen, cinema-quality projection and professional sound, set up beautifully at your place — then packed away when the credits roll.

From intimate backyard premieres to large community screenings and drive-in spectaculars, every event is tailored to your occasion, your audience and your space.

Questions

Before the Lights Dim

What equipment is included, and who sets it up?+

Every booking includes the cinema screen, cinema-quality projection and a professional sound system, with full setup before your event and complete pack-down afterwards. Exact screen sizes and equipment configurations for your event are confirmed in your itemised quote — to be confirmed at enquiry.

Where can an outdoor cinema event be held?+

Backyards, private venues, school grounds, community spaces, corporate sites and open fields for drive-ins are all possible settings. The locations and service areas currently covered are to be confirmed — tell us where your event is in the enquiry form and we will confirm what is possible.

What happens if the weather turns?+

Outdoor screenings are weather-dependent, and arrangements for wet or windy conditions — including any reschedule options — are to be confirmed at the time of booking. We recommend mentioning a backup plan or indoor alternative in your enquiry so it can be discussed up front.

Can you screen for both private and public events?+

Yes — we cater for private celebrations as well as public and community screenings. Public screenings may require film licensing arrangements; the exact requirements for your event are to be confirmed when you enquire.

How does booking and pricing work?+

It starts with a free enquiry. You will receive an itemised quote tailored to your event, and a deposit secures your date. Pricing is provided by quote only — no prices are published on this website, and the deposit amount for your booking is to be confirmed in your quote.

What do we need to provide at our venue?+

Mainly a suitable space for the screen and your audience, with access for setup. Specific requirements such as power access and site conditions depend on the experience you choose and are to be confirmed once we know your event details.
